module Main where

import Auction
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

-- Note that, in a real implementation, `CompleteAuction` would
-- be triggered externally by a process at `Auction.end` time.
setup = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  now <- getTime
  ipoId <- submit seller do
    createCmd Auction with
      security = "DA Ltd"
      quantity = 1_000_000
      seller = seller
      start = now
      end = addRelTime now (minutes 3)
  aliceInviteId <- submit seller do
    exerciseCmd ipoId InviteBidder with buyer = alice
  bobInviteId <- submit seller do
    exerciseCmd ipoId InviteBidder with buyer = bob
  aliceBidId <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd aliceInviteId SubmitBid
      with price = 99.0 ; quantity = 600_000
  bobBidId <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd bobInviteId SubmitBid
      with price = 97.0 ; quantity = 800_000
  submit seller do
    exerciseCmd ipoId CompleteAuction with bidIds = [aliceBidId, bobBidId]

module Main where

import Auction
import Daml.Script
import DA.Date (datetime, Month(..))

startTime : Time
startTime = datetime 2020 Jan 1 0 0 0

endTime : Time
endTime = datetime 2020 Jan 2 0 0 0

auctionFor : Party -> Int -> Auction
auctionFor seller amount = Auction with
  security = "Example security"
  quantity = amount
  seller
  start = startTime
  end = endTime

allocationFor : Party -> Decimal -> Int -> Allocation
allocationFor party price quantity = Allocation with party; price; quantity

allocationMath : Script ()
allocationMath = script do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  let requested = allocationFor alice 10.0 4
  assert (allocBids 10 requested == (6, requested))
  assert (allocBids 4 requested == (0, requested))
  assert (allocBids 2 requested == (0, requested with quantity = 2))
  assert (allocBids 0 requested == (0, requested with quantity = 0))

auctionValidationAndAuthorization : Script ()
auctionValidationAndAuthorization = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  submitMustFail seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 0)
  submitMustFail seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller (-1))
  submitMustFail seller do createCmd ((auctionFor seller 1) with start = endTime; end = endTime)
  submitMustFail seller do createCmd ((auctionFor seller 1) with start = endTime; end = startTime)
  submitMustFail alice do createCmd (auctionFor seller 1)
  auctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 1)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd auctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [])
  invitationId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  submitMustFail seller do exerciseCmd invitationId (SubmitBid with price = 5.0; quantity = 1)

biddingWindow : Script ()
biddingWindow = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  auctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 4)
  invitationId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  setTime (datetime 2019 Dec 31 23 59 59)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd invitationId (SubmitBid with price = 10.0; quantity = 1)
  setTime startTime
  firstBidId <- submit alice do exerciseCmd invitationId (SubmitBid with price = 10.0; quantity = 1)
  firstBid <- queryContractId alice firstBidId
  assert (firstBid == Some (Bid with auction = auctionFor seller 4; allocation = allocationFor alice 10.0 1))
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd invitationId (SubmitBid with price = 11.0; quantity = 1)
  nextInvitationId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  setTime endTime
  lastBidId <- submit alice do exerciseCmd nextInvitationId (SubmitBid with price = 12.0; quantity = 2)
  lastBid <- queryContractId seller lastBidId
  assert (lastBid == Some (Bid with auction = auctionFor seller 4; allocation = allocationFor alice 12.0 2))
  lateInvitationId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  setTime (datetime 2020 Jan 2 0 0 1)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd lateInvitationId (SubmitBid with price = 13.0; quantity = 1)

pricePriorityAndPartialFill : Script ()
pricePriorityAndPartialFill = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  charlie <- allocateParty "Charlie"
  setTime startTime
  auctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 10)
  aliceInvitation <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  bobInvitation <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = bob)
  charlieInvitation <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = charlie)
  aliceBid <- submit alice do exerciseCmd aliceInvitation (SubmitBid with price = 20.0; quantity = 7)
  bobBid <- submit bob do exerciseCmd bobInvitation (SubmitBid with price = 30.0; quantity = 6)
  charlieBid <- submit charlie do exerciseCmd charlieInvitation (SubmitBid with price = 10.0; quantity = 5)
  resultId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [charlieBid, aliceBid, bobBid])
  result <- queryContractId seller resultId
  assert (result == Some (AuctionResult with auction = auctionFor seller 10; allocations = [allocationFor bob 30.0 6, allocationFor alice 20.0 4, allocationFor charlie 10.0 0]))
  submitMustFail seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [])

emptyAndExactAuctions : Script ()
emptyAndExactAuctions = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  setTime startTime
  emptyAuctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 3)
  emptyResultId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd emptyAuctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [])
  emptyResult <- queryContractId seller emptyResultId
  assert (emptyResult == Some (AuctionResult with auction = auctionFor seller 3; allocations = []))
  auctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 3)
  invitationId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  bidId <- submit alice do exerciseCmd invitationId (SubmitBid with price = 7.5; quantity = 3)
  resultId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [bidId])
  result <- queryContractId seller resultId
  assert (result == Some (AuctionResult with auction = auctionFor seller 3; allocations = [allocationFor alice 7.5 3]))

bidPrivacyAndResultVisibility : Script ()
bidPrivacyAndResultVisibility = script do
  seller <- allocateParty "Seller"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  setTime startTime
  auctionId <- submit seller do createCmd (auctionFor seller 2)
  aliceInvitation <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = alice)
  bobInvitation <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (InviteBidder with buyer = bob)
  aliceViewOfBobInvitation <- queryContractId alice bobInvitation
  assert (aliceViewOfBobInvitation == None)
  submitMustFail seller do createCmd (Bid with auction = auctionFor seller 2; allocation = allocationFor alice 9.0 1)
  aliceBid <- submit alice do exerciseCmd aliceInvitation (SubmitBid with price = 9.0; quantity = 1)
  bobViewOfAliceBid <- queryContractId bob aliceBid
  assert (bobViewOfAliceBid == None)
  sellerViewOfBid <- queryContractId seller aliceBid
  assert (sellerViewOfBid == Some (Bid with auction = auctionFor seller 2; allocation = allocationFor alice 9.0 1))
  resultId <- submit seller do exerciseCmd auctionId (CompleteAuction with bidIds = [aliceBid])
  aliceViewOfResult <- queryContractId alice resultId
  assert (aliceViewOfResult == Some (AuctionResult with auction = auctionFor seller 2; allocations = [allocationFor alice 9.0 1]))
  bobViewOfResult <- queryContractId bob resultId
  assert (bobViewOfResult == None)
